task.description: WF-02 Step 2b (review) for REQ-035 on branch feature/WF02-REQ-035. Read git diff master...HEAD, check against the design system, anti-patterns.md, decisions/0004 and 0006, scope vs the 10 ACs, and re-run lint/build/tests independently. Specific scrutiny requested on: the BACKEND-DEV search-mechanism deviation (command-line query arg vs unspecified 'callback flow'); decideApprovalOutcome/approveRequest's row-lock shape vs commitWalkin; distinct audit actions for approve vs approve_override; decideRejectionOutcome/rejectRequest's reason-capture scope; S3 select-clause exclusion of phone/email; S2 requireOrganizerForChapter on every handler entry point; overrideAdmitAndCheckIn non-reuse; zero-Wishlist grep; no second QR generator; lint/build/test re-run.
acceptance_criteria: Search-mechanism deviation assessed as either a no-behavioral-consequence plumbing choice or an unauthorized scope decision.
approveRequest's SELECT...FOR UPDATE + fresh in-tx re-read pattern confirmed to mirror commitWalkin's shape by reading both side by side.
generateQrToken() confirmed as the only QR-token call site touched, no second generator introduced.
Distinct audit actions confirmed for approve vs approve-override branches.
Rejection reason confirmed captured only in the audit payload, not written to registrations.noShowReason or any other column.
Reject notification message confirmed to contain both the reason and the onward-path string.
listPendingRequestsForOrganizer and getPendingRequestForOrganizer select clauses confirmed to structurally exclude phone/email by reading the actual query.
requireOrganizerForChapter confirmed called on every handler entry point (list, page, detail, approve, approve_confirm, reject, reject-text-reply).
overrideAdmitAndCheckIn (checkinQr.ts/REQ-029) confirmed to have zero diff.
Wishlist grep independently re-run, zero entity/table/row matches.
No second QR-token generator confirmed via grep.
npm run lint -w apps/bot, npm run build -w apps/bot, npx vitest run --no-file-parallelism re-run and their real output recorded.

result.summary: Read git diff master...HEAD in full (registration.ts new exports, the new organizerRequests.ts handler file, i18n additions, index.ts wiring) against docs/agents/design/REQ-035.md and issue #67's 10 ACs. SEARCH-MECHANISM DEVIATION: the design's own §6.1 prose says the search query 'arrives via a callback flow, not the initial command' but §1.1 and §8 Open Question 2 explicitly name the exact mechanism as BACKEND-DEV's plumbing choice with 'no behavioral consequence either way', citing PAGE_SIZE/SEARCH_RESULT_LIMIT reuse from handlers/checkin.ts. BACKEND-DEV implemented /requests <event_id> [query] as a second command-line token (parseRequestsCommandArgs, organizerRequests.ts lines 70-79), the identical shape /checkin already uses and already has test coverage for. This is a plumbing choice within an explicitly-delegated open question, not a business-rule invention or a UX change no AC anticipated (no AC pins a specific search UI) -- judged consistent with an authorized, precedent-following implementation choice. Not a finding. CONCURRENCY/OVERRIDE (§0.1/§0.2, AC4/AC5): read commitWalkin (domain/walkin.ts lines 218-387) and approveRequest (domain/registration.ts, new) side by side -- both lock the registration/events row via `.for("update")` inside `db.transaction`, both take a fresh in-tx admitted count via countAdmittedRegistrations before the pure decision, both write conditionally. approveRequest additionally locks the registrations row itself first (registration.ts lines ~1610-1621) before locking events (~1631-1637), a superset of commitWalkin's shape, not a deviation from it. generateQrToken() grep (apps/bot/src) shows exactly one definition (registration.ts line 91) and all call sites -- including the new approveRequest call (line ~1810 per backend-dev's own citation, confirmed present) -- call the existing function; no second generator defined anywhere. Distinct audit actions confirmed: `outcome.kind === "approve" ? "registration.approve" : "registration.approve_override"` (registration.ts, approveRequest step 7), mirroring commitWalkin's own `seatsLeft > 0 ? "registration.walkin_admit" : "registration.walkin_override_admit"` naming convention exactly. REJECTION (§4.1/§4.2, AC2): decideRejectionOutcome/rejectRequest read in full -- the UPDATE touches only `admission: "rejected"`; `noShowReason` is never referenced anywhere in either function or the diff (grep confirms). The reason string is passed only into `writeAuditLog`'s `payload: { eventId, reason }` -- no other write path exists for it. sendRejectionNotification (organizerRequests.ts lines 511-543) composes the message as `[rejectedNotificationPrefix, rejectedNotificationReasonPrefix + reason, catalog.event.deepLinkSeeUpcoming].join("\n")` -- both the verbatim reason and the existing onward-path string are always present, unconditionally, in every reject send. S3 (AC8): read listPendingRequestsForOrganizer's and getPendingRequestForOrganizer's actual `.select({...})` object literals (registration.ts) -- both list exactly registrationId/userId/firstName/lastName/tgUsername/company/position/isStudent/source/createdAt(+admission for the detail read); `profiles.phone`/`profiles.email` do not appear as selected columns, keys, or joins anywhere in either query -- structural exclusion confirmed by reading the query, not trusting the summary. S2 (AC6/AC7): traced every handler in organizerRequests.ts -- makeRequestsListHandler (line 241), makeRequestsPageCallbackHandler (line 277), makeRequestDetailCallbackHandler (line 321), makeRequestApproveCallbackHandler (line 410), makeRequestApproveConfirmCallbackHandler (line 451), makeRequestRejectCallbackHandler (line 576), and makeRequestRejectTextReplyHandler (line 631, re-checked because the text reply itself is the write-triggering action) each call `requireOrganizerForChapter(db, BigInt(tgId), event.chapterId)` before any read/write beyond resolving the event, and each resolves `event.chapterId` from the registration's/command's OWN event, never a caller-supplied chapter (AC7). makeRequestApproveCancelCallbackHandler is the sole exception and correctly so -- it performs no domain call at all, only a reply, so no authorization gate is needed for a pure no-op (AC4's dismiss path). overrideAdmitAndCheckIn NON-REUSE: `git diff master...HEAD --stat -- apps/bot/src/handlers/checkinQr.ts` returns empty -- zero changes, confirmed independently. WISHLIST GREP: re-ran `grep -rin wishlist apps/bot/src apps/bot/migrations` myself -- one hit, a code comment in organizerRequests.ts citing the design's own 'zero Wishlist' decision (§0.4/§5); no entity/table/column/row named wishlist or a synonym anywhere (AC3). ANTI-PATTERNS/DECISIONS: checked docs/agents/anti-patterns.md (no entries yet applicable) and decisions/0004 (domain logic in framework-free modules, handlers only sequence) -- confirmed: all new decision/write functions (listPendingRequestsForOrganizer, getPendingRequestForOrganizer, decideApprovalOutcome, approveRequest, decideRejectionOutcome, rejectRequest) live in domain/registration.ts; organizerRequests.ts contains no domain rule, only authorization checks, calls into the domain layer, and reply/render composition. decisions/0006's now()/current_timestamp boundary: grepped registration.ts and organizerRequests.ts for now()/current_timestamp/new Date() -- no SQL now() anywhere; `new Date()` appears only at the three handler call sites (organizerRequests.ts lines 416, 457, 642) passed as an explicit `at` parameter into approveRequest/rejectRequest, matching every other transactional writer's existing convention in this file -- not a time-dependent predicate, and this feature has no time-gated query at all (approve/reject are not scheduled-job behavior; that is REQ-036's explicit scope, correctly excluded here). DESIGN SYSTEM: this is a bot-only (apps/bot/**) change with no src/ or public/ touched (confirmed via `git diff --name-only` filtered to src/|public/, zero results) -- no tokens/type-scale/spacing/component-class/icon rules apply; i18n additions are placeholder copy per decisions/0002 (CONTENT-BA owns final wording), consistent with every prior bot requirement's convention. SCOPE: diff matches the design's stated file list exactly (registration.ts, organizerRequests.ts new, i18n x3, index.ts) -- no schema/migration file touched, no unrelated files changed. CHECKS RE-RUN, real output: `npm run lint -w apps/bot` -> clean, no output, exit 0. `npm run build -w apps/bot` -> clean tsc, no output, exit 0. `npx vitest run --no-file-parallelism` -> 'Test Files 37 passed (37)', 'Tests 343 passed (343)', 58.28s -- matches BACKEND-DEV's reported count, zero regressions. No npm workspace added/renamed/removed and no build-output location changed by this diff, so the Dockerfile-build re-verification (ISS-0005) does not apply to this run.
